name: ZCA_INTG_DATA_ERRORS
description: The table zca_intg_data_errors stores the error record with pk/puid for batch integration.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: The primary key and unique identifier of the error record.

columns.name: ERROR_DETAILS
columns.description: The details of the error occurred when the target application API was invoked.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the integration intance.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the integration instance details.

columns.name: OBJECT_PK1
columns.description: Columns for storing the primary key of the customer records.

columns.name: OBJECT_PK2
columns.description: Columns for storing the primary key of the customer records.

columns.name: OBJECT_PK3
columns.description: Columns for storing the primary key of the customer records.

columns.name: OBJECT_PK4
columns.description: Columns for storing the primary key of the customer records.

columns.name: OBJECT_PK5
columns.description: Columns for storing the primary key of the customer records.

columns.name: OBJECT_PUID
columns.description: Columns for storing the public unique identifier of the customer records.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: The object meta data code to identify the object  that is being synched with the target application.

columns.name: STAGE
columns.description: This column holds the current stage value of integration like EXTRACTION / ENRICH / INVOKE.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
